def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    asset_cash_flows = [500000, 300000, 200000]
    liability_cash_flows = [400000, 250000, 150000]
    discount_rate = 0.05

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    present_value_assets = sum(
        cash_flow / ((1 + discount_rate) ** (period + 1))
        for period, cash_flow in enumerate(asset_cash_flows)
    )
    present_value_liabilities = sum(
        cash_flow / ((1 + discount_rate) ** (period + 1))
        for period, cash_flow in enumerate(liability_cash_flows)
    )
    answer = round(present_value_assets - present_value_liabilities)

    # return answer
    return answer
